predeclared_tonic_runaway_gate.interpretation: near-saturated sustained global tonic plateau; oscillation depth is not required

bounded_gate.interpretation: low or spatially localized/partially recruited attractor

claim_boundary: The fixed-point saddle-node, delay-system attractor boundary, and finite-time threshold crossing are reported separately. A sharp operational boundary is not called a local bifurcation without continuation or stability evidence for the relevant attractor.
